title: Is a dose required for every pig when treatment is recorded for several?
detail: Record treatment for several pigs has a "Same dose for all" control that fills every pig's Dose box, and each pig keeps its own box. Today Save waits until every ticked pig has a dose above 0. That is a product rule on what is recorded, so the design keeps it as it is. The design only asks whether a pig may be saved without a dose.
options: Keep it: every ticked pig needs a dose above 0
A pig with no dose is saved as treated without a dose
A pig with no dose is left out of the record, and the row says so
recommendation: Keep it: a treatment record without a dose cannot be audited. Owner to rule.
